Toi HUNG dai dien THU HOI NO thuc
dia yeu cad
co mat tai dia chi THUONG TRU va
gia dinh NO LA PHAI TRA do la quy
luat, toi da hoan tat ho so va chung
cu ve hanh vi LUA DAO - CHIEM
DOAT TAI SAN (Dieu 174 BLHS,
khung 7-15 NAM TU). O doi co vay la
phai co tra neu van co tinh tron tranh
va khong co dong thai giai quyet,
dung chieu nay, chung toi se ket hop
cung Cong An Kinh Te truc tiep
xuong nha theo dia chi ho khau de
doi chap cong khai truoc chinh
quyen. DUNG THACH THUC PHAP
LUAT, hop tac giai quyet thi toi con
tao dieu kien de tra con ngoan co thi
dung trach ben toi khong canh cao
truoc.
